data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $130.209 million, representing a 12.9% increase over opening gross reserves. This strengthening was driven by the need to reinforce back year reserves in certain long-tail classes, particularly Professional Indemnity, Financial Institutions, Miscellaneous, and Management & Transactional Liability. Contributing factors included an extensive review of old case files, unexpected adverse US court rulings, and the unprecedented effects of the Coronavirus pandemic combined with natural catastrophe activity.

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a 'net deterioration of ($53,039,944)' in Note 5 on page 25, but the gross prior year development calculated from the claims development triangle on page 36 is $130.209 million. The narrative on page 6 mentions a contribution of $53m to losses from specific causes, which is likely a net figure. The gross figure from the triangle is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. The report also mentions a Part VII transfer (RITC) on 30 December 2020, but states 'no movements were processed on these policies on 31 December 2020', suggesting the claims development triangle reflects underlying development rather than the RITC transfer itself for the year-end estimates.
